性能：所得负极在10 A g−1下循环15000次后仍保持151.4 mAh g−1和84.9%容量保持率；与高镍正极组成的全电池在6 C下循环1000次几乎无容量衰减。

新在哪里：用无氟双功能小分子麦芽酚在共享电解液中同步调控锌负极和碘正极，避免传统策略分别修饰两极却忽略物种跨界面迁移的问题。
性能：I−正极液体系循环超过35000次，单圈容量衰减0.0007%；固载碘体系在约2 mAh cm−2下循环11000次后仍保持83.8%容量，0.54 Ah软包电池累计输出超过250 Ah。
怎么解释：麦芽酚在锌表面协同平面吸附并重构内亥姆霍兹层（inner Helmholtz plane, IHP），抑制水/硫酸根副反应并调节成核；其多齿氧位点同时锚定并削弱I3−，限制穿梭并促进I2/I−转化。
为什么重要：该工作说明双电极失效可以通过同一电解液分子的界面选择性作用协同处理，为减少含氟添加剂、构建长寿命锌–碘电池提供了较完整的分子设计范式。

papers.title: Non‐Entangled Chains Enable Rapid Na + Transport Through Ion‐Traps in Gel Polymer Electrolytes at Low Temperatures

matchedTopics: Ion-conducting polymers and single-ion conductors
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将低温凝胶聚合物电解质中的链缠结明确为“离子陷阱”来源，并以非缠结聚1,3-二氧戊环构建连续、均一的Na+配位环境，而不是单纯通过增加液相含量提高电导率。
性能：非缠结网络使Na+迁移数达到0.85，在−50 °C仍具有0.25 mS cm−1离子电导率；Na||Na3V2(PO4)3全电池在−40 °C下容量保持率接近100%。
怎么解释：减少链缠结可缩短链松弛时间、增加自由体积并降低离子陷阱密度，同时促进NaTFSI解离和连续Na+扩散；更均匀的Na+通量进一步对应更薄、更均一的SEI。
为什么重要：工作把低温传输瓶颈从笼统的链段运动不足细化为可由拓扑结构调节的离子陷阱，为在不依赖大量增塑剂的情况下设计低温聚合物电解质提供了新路径。

papers.title: Engineering the Interfacial Microenvironment of Fe–N–C Cathode to Boost Proton Conduction for High-Performance Fuel Cells

papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：通过碳纳米管（carbon nanotubes, CNTs）表面含氧基团与离聚物侧链的非共价作用，重构Fe–N–C阴极的催化剂–离聚物–反应物三相界面，把质子传输作为阴极层的直接设计变量。
性能：与常规结构相比，阴极层质子电导率提高2.3倍；质子交换膜燃料电池（proton-exchange membrane fuel cell, PEMFC）峰值功率密度达到1.63 W cm⁻²，在0.9 V（iR校正）时电流密度为53 mA cm⁻²。
怎么解释：含氧界面促进水富集并增强水分子间作用，形成连续氢键水网络；粗粒化分子动力学模拟支持该网络有利于长程质子跳跃。该机制由模拟与电导率变化共同支持，但摘要未给出区分不同含氧基团贡献的对照。
为什么重要：结果表明，非铂氧还原催化剂（oxygen reduction reaction, ORR）的器件性能不仅取决于活性位点，还受催化层内质子输运限制；界面微环境可成为连接催化剂结构与膜电极性能的设计层级。

papers.title: Enabling Fast Charging of Lithium‐Ion Batteries With Regioisomeric Nitrile Additives for Interphase Regulation
papers.authors: Chen Liu, Zehao Cui, Arumugam Manthiram
papers.authorsCitation: C. Liu, Z. Cui, A. Manthiram
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：以仅0.5 wt.%的区域异构腈类添加剂3-(三氟甲基)苯甲腈调控正、负极电解质界面，同时保持与商业LP57电解液兼容。
性能：在1 Ah石墨||NCM811软包电池中实现更好的快充表现，并改善低温、高温和高电压稳定性；摘要未给出软包快充循环的具体倍率与保持率。
怎么解释：添加剂在负极优先还原，形成约10 nm的受控固体电解质界面膜（solid electrolyte interphase, SEI），而LP57形成约450 nm的富锂层；在正极侧则形成更薄、更均匀的正极电解质界面膜（cathode electrolyte interphase, CEI）。弛豫时间分布（distribution of relaxation times, DRT）分析显示界面阻抗降低，并伴随锂沉积受抑。
为什么重要：该工作把添加剂的区域异构结构与双界面成膜差异联系起来，为不更换主体电解液条件下改善快充提供了较接近产业配方的路径。

papers.title: Data-Driven Design of Asymmetric, Fluorine-Free Ethers for High-Voltage Lithium-Metal Batteries under Extreme Conditions
papers.authors: Hanjun Li, Yecheng Leng, Wanbao Wu, Tingting Wu, Yuchen Yang, Xuyang Zhang, Chaowei Li, Mingjin Cui, Xinghai Ning, Xi Zhu, Yu Zhao, Haoshen Zhou, Yu Ding

papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Lithium-metal and anode-free batteries
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：将数据驱动筛选与分子设计结合，从千余种候选物中提出不对称、无氟醚溶剂，通过醚链长度和配位氧电子不等价同时调节高电压稳定性、挥发性与去溶剂化动力学。
性能：Li||LiCoO₂电池在−40 °C保留室温容量的81.2%，循环300次后容量保持率为91.3%；1 Ah软包电池在−35 °C保留71.9%容量，5 Ah软包电池在1 g Ah⁻¹贫液条件下达到475 Wh kg⁻¹。
怎么解释：较长醚链通过多齿配位提高抗氧化与抗挥发能力；分子不对称性使不同配位氧具有不等价结合强度，在保持多齿配位热力学稳定性的同时，由较弱位点降低去溶剂化的动力学约束。该解释由计算和实验共同支持，但摘要未说明各描述符的独立贡献。
为什么重要：结果说明无氟并不必然以牺牲高电压或低温性能为代价，并给出可被继续检验的结构变量，而不是仅依赖经验性含氟化设计。

papers.title: An Ultrafast-Charging Daniell-Type All-Solid-State Battery
papers.authors: Tao Yu, Haoyu Li, Zhu Cheng, Zhaoguo Liu, Daxian Zuo, Sheng Xu, Bo Peng, Ruilin Hou, Yuan Rao, Shaohua Guo, Marnix Wagemaker, Haoshen Zhou

papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Solid-state batteries
Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：构建Li⁺与Cu⁺共同迁移的电解质框架，以平面金属电极形成丹尼尔型全固态电池（Daniell-type all-solid-state battery），绕开粉体复合电极中的曲折离子/电子传输路径。
性能：电流密度由1.0提高至10.0 mA cm⁻²时容量保持率为100%，平均放电电压仅降低约45 mV；在30 °C、10.0 mA cm⁻²循环10000次，在60 °C、100.0 mA cm⁻²循环25000次后仍报告100%容量保持。
怎么解释：作者将快速动力学归因于平面金属电极消除了多相颗粒点接触与曲折输运，并由稳定的界面微结构维持长期循环。摘要尚不足以判断容量负载、面积容量及能量密度是否与常规全固态电池具有同等可比性。
为什么重要：该体系提出了不同于粉体正极的全固态电池构型，提示电极几何与载流离子协同迁移可能比单纯提高固态电解质电导率更直接地改变倍率边界。

papers.title: A Dual‐Interface Stabilizing Additive for High‐voltage Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Minyi Zou, Yuanchang Ye, Yingxia Dong, Haihua Li, Junkai Shi, Bomao Huang, Changhong Li, Pengcheng Xue, Ruirui Zhao, Liang Ma, Junpeng Xie, Qifeng Zheng

matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：以3-吡啶基三氟硼酸钾作为双界面添加剂，利用吡啶基调节阴离子电子结构和Na⁺结合能力，使同一分子分别参与负极SEI与正极CEI形成。
性能：Na||Na对称电池在5 mA cm⁻²下循环6000 h；Na||Cu平均库仑效率为99.89%；Na||Na₃V₂(PO₄)₂F₃电池在4.3 V、10 C循环10000次后容量保持率为90.8%，在4.4 V循环2500次后为90.0%。
怎么解释：PBF₃⁻优先还原并形成富NaF的SEI，抑制枝晶；B–F键断裂同时促进薄而均匀的富NaF CEI，降低高电压电解液氧化。摘要支持成膜组成与性能相关，但尚不能单凭这些信息确认两侧界面作用的相对贡献。
为什么重要：该设计尝试用单一添加剂同时解决钠金属沉积与高电压正极氧化两个失效源，为低添加量双界面调控提供了明确的分子电子结构依据。

papers.title: Descriptor‐Guided Dynamic Solvation‐Shell Reconstruction Enables PEO‐Based Polymer Electrolytes With 10.9 mS cm −1 Ionic Conductivity
papers.authors: Yutong Zhai, Botian Zheng, Ning Wang, Pingbo Xu, Tianzong Ma, Tong Wu, Lina Cong, Haiming Xie, Yulong Liu
papers.authorsCitation: Y. Zhai, B. Zheng, N. Wang, P. Xu, T. Ma, T. Wu, L. Cong, H. Xie, Y. Liu
matchedTopics: Ion-conducting polymers and single-ion conductors
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：采用描述符引导的动态溶剂化壳层重构，在聚氧化乙烯（poly(ethylene oxide), PEO）准固态电解质中引入兼具竞争性Li⁺亲和力和快速局部扩散的腈类增塑剂。
性能：优化电解质室温离子电导率达到10.9 mS cm⁻¹，较原始PEO提高近三个数量级；摘要仅说明Li||NCM811电池可稳定快充和低温运行，未提供对应倍率、温度与循环数据。
怎么解释：腈配体进入第一溶剂化壳层，削弱持续的Li⁺–醚氧配位，使迁移由聚合物笼限跳跃转向配体交换辅助传输；同时改变界面分解路径，抑制高电压下PEO氧化并形成更致密的CEI。
为什么重要：工作将体相离子输运与高电压界面稳定性放在同一溶剂化结构变量下讨论，为PEO体系中电导率与界面稳定性同步改善提供了可量化的分子筛选思路。

papers.title: Adaptive Solvation Evolution by Molecular Design Enables High‐Performance Wide‐Temperature Lithium‐Ion Batteries
papers.authors: Tianhao Lan, Yun Ji, Xin Fang, Yihui Liu, Haipeng You, Long Chen, Chunzhong Li
papers.authorsCitation: T. Lan, Y. Ji, X. Fang, Y. Liu, H. You, L. Chen, C. Li
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：通过α-甲基取代溶剂产生局部位阻屏蔽，调节溶剂–Li⁺–阴离子配位随温度的变化，构建温度自适应溶剂化结构。
性能：1 Ah LFP||石墨软包电池在25 °C、2 C循环2000次后保持87.4%容量，并在−60 °C输出0.47 Ah；1 Ah NMC811||石墨软包电池在25 °C、1 C循环4000次后保持83.2%，在−80 °C输出0.49 Ah，并可在100 °C运行。
怎么解释：作者将宽温性能归因于α-甲基位阻对配位强度的动态调节，使低温离子传输与高温稳定性得到兼顾。摘要没有列出不同温度下溶剂化结构的直接表征，因此具体温度响应机制仍需正文证据确认。
为什么重要：相比为单一低温或高温条件优化固定溶剂化结构，该策略关注配位关系随温度的演化，并在商业尺寸软包电池中检验，具有更明确的宽温应用相关性。

papers.title: A Fullerene-Based Interphase Confines Interfacial Electrons for Long-Lived Zinc Metal Anodes in Aqueous Electrolytes
papers.authors: Baoshan Wu, Wei Tang, Tingkuo Zhang, Mingwei An, Ziyang Hao, Zuochang Chen, Hanrui Tian, Nan Zhao, Jianbiao Fan, Peng Du, Yang Wang, Panfeng Zhao, Xiaobin Niu
papers.authorsCitation: B. Wu, W. Tang, T. Zhang, M. An, Z. Hao, Z. Chen, H. Tian, N. Zhao, J. Fan, P. Du, Y. Wang, P. Zhao, X. Niu
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：在锌表面构建富勒烯聚合物界面层，利用C₆₀较高电子亲和力限制界面电子分布，从电子结构层面调节锌沉积与水系副反应。
性能：PC60/Zn对称电池稳定循环超过5500 h，半电池在5500次循环中库仑效率超过99.9%，PC60/Zn||ZnI₂全电池循环1000次后容量保持率超过96%。
怎么解释：电子缺陷C₆₀笼与极性酯、胺基共同形成致密界面，并诱导负电性钝化层；原位差分电化学质谱（differential electrochemical mass spectrometry, DEMS）、X射线衍射、拉曼光谱和开尔文探针力显微镜（Kelvin probe force microscopy, KPFM）共同支持析氢、碱式硫酸锌生成和腐蚀受抑，同时Zn²⁺传输与表面电势更均匀。
为什么重要：该工作把界面电子分布作为可调变量，尝试将锌氧化还原与析氢、腐蚀等副反应分离，为水系金属负极界面层设计增加了不同于机械阻隔和溶剂化调控的维度。

papers.title: Steric‐Electronic Engineering of Ester Carbonyls Enables Thermodynamic‐Kinetic Regulation of Electron Transfer for High‐Voltage and High‐Rate Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Zhiwei Ni, Yuan Li, Huizi Zhang, Chenghui Zhang, Baojuan Xi, Shenglin Xiong, Jinkui Feng
papers.authorsCitation: Z. Ni, Y. Li, H. Zhang, C. Zhang, B. Xi, S. Xiong, J. Feng
matchedTopics: Lithium-metal and anode-free batteries
Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：通过酯羰基的位阻–电子协同调节，同时在热力学和动力学上限制电子转移，并改变溶剂化结构，使乙酸新戊酯类电解液的无序还原转化为受控界面成膜。
性能：电解液支持−40至50 °C运行，并在4.6 V、10 C条件下驱动Li||NCM811电池；2.5 Ah软包电池在负正极容量比0.94、1.17 g Ah⁻¹贫液条件下达到432 Wh kg⁻¹。摘要称4.6 V循环300次容量衰减可忽略，但未给出数值。
怎么解释：作者认为酯羰基周围的电子与空间环境降低其接受电子并发生非受控还原的倾向，同时重塑Li⁺溶剂化和界面分解路径。摘要未给出热力学势垒与电子转移速率的独立证据，二者的相对作用仍需正文确认。
为什么重要：酯类溶剂成本和质量优势明显，但还原稳定性通常不足；该工作提供了从羰基局部结构出发改善锂金属兼容性的分子设计方向。

papers.title: Moderately Solvated Electrolyte Enabling Fast Charging of a Lithium-Ion Battery at Low Temperature
papers.authors: Ziwen Zha, Aoxuan Wang, Zhengfei Zhao, Zhenglin Hu, Fuqiang Huang, Jiayan Luo
papers.authorsCitation: Z. Zha, A. Wang, Z. Zhao, Z. Hu, F. Huang, J. Luo
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：提出适度溶剂化电解液，通过调节溶剂–Li⁺–阴离子相互作用，在低温体相离子输运与界面去溶剂化之间取得平衡，而非单向追求弱溶剂化。
性能：石墨||LiCoO₂全电池在−20 °C、1 C循环1500次后容量保持率为82.8%；在−40 °C仍可按0.5 C可逆循环，1 Ah软包电池在−40 °C容量保持率超过90%。
怎么解释：由亚硫酸二甲酯与丙酮组成的体系富含接触离子对（contact ion pairs, CIPs），既保留足够的液相离子传输，又降低界面去溶剂化能垒，从而缓解低温下两类动力学限制。摘要未给出各过程的定量贡献。
为什么重要：结果说明低温快充的优化目标不是简单增强解离或减弱溶剂化，而是寻找体相与界面动力学的中间区间，为电解液配位强度设计提供了更可操作的判断框架。

papers.title: Solvation‐Gradient Thin‐Film Composite Membranes Decouple Ferricyanide Rejection From Hydroxide Conduction in Alkaline Zinc–Iron Flow Batteries
papers.authors: Junhua Li, Dan Li, Yijing Dai, Zilin Zhao, Yuzhang Zhu, Jian Jin
papers.authorsCitation: J. Li, D. Li, Y. Dai, Z. Zhao, Y. Zhu, J. Jin
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：通过反应–扩散耦合界面聚合构建沿厚度方向变化的溶剂化梯度膜，将铁氰根排斥与OH⁻传导分配到不同空间区域。
性能：优化膜的Fe(CN)₆³⁻渗透率为8.07 × 10⁻⁷ cm² h⁻¹，OH⁻电导率为41.08 mS cm⁻¹；碱性锌–铁液流电池在80 mA cm⁻²下能量效率为89.94%，稳定运行超过800 h。
怎么解释：约35 nm致密外层以约6 Å孔径提高大离子进入和去溶剂化势垒；约400 nm富NH内层通过再溶剂化与氢键重排促进OH⁻迁移。深度分辨光谱和分子动力学模拟支持膜内溶剂化环境随深度变化。
为什么重要：该结构不要求单一均匀通道同时满足高选择性和高电导率，而是用空间分工缓解二者的竞争，为电化学分离膜的非均相结构设计提供了清晰范式。

papers.title: A Stage‐Coupled View of Interfacial Reconstruction in Anode‐Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Jiawen Dai, Rui Zhang, Shengan Wu, Yougen Tang, Haiyan Wang
papers.authorsCitation: J. Dai, R. Zhang, S. Wu, Y. Tang, H. Wang
matchedTopics: Fast charging and interfacial ion transport
papers.summaryZh:
新在哪里：该综述不把无负极钠金属电池视为具有固定界面的体系，而是以“溶剂化控制的界面进入—集流体调节的钠重构—反应路径与力学完整性控制的SEI更新”三个连续阶段组织失效机制。

papers.title: Programming Ion‐Engineered Interphase for Practical Zinc Batteries Through Exogenous Cation‐Anion Synergy Chemistry
papers.authors: Qiwen Zhao, Yuejiao Chen, Wen Liu, Huaming Yu, Bingang Xu, Liangliang Jiang, Aliakbar Hassanpouryouzband, Eman Ramadan Elsharkawy, Qichun Zhang, Libao Chen
papers.authorsCitation: Q. Zhao, Y. Chen, W. Liu, H. Yu, B. Xu, L. Jiang, A. Hassanpouryouzband, E. R. Elsharkawy, Q. Zhang, L. Chen
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT A stable anode‐electrolyte interface is vital for battery cycling. Translating the successful anion‐derived interphase paradigm from Li‐ion to aqueous Zn‐ion batteries (ZIBs) is hindered by narrow electrochemical windows and chaotic interfacial reactions. Here we overcome this by programming interphase formation via exogenous cation–anion synergy. Hydrolysable anions drive the rapid formation of an inorganic‐rich interphase, while weakly hydrated bulky cations with low ionic potential ( φ ) dually function as noncorrosive electrostatic shields and field‐driven anion receptors to dynamically regulate the interfacial environment without parasitic reactions. As a proof of concept, importing tetramethylfluorourea hexafluorophosphate into ZnSO 4 electrolyte enables precise modulation of the distribution and conversion of H 2 O, SO 4 2− and Zn 2+ at the Zn interface. This resulting composite interface (ZnF 2 , ZnS, ZnO, and C─N species) improves Zn 2+ transport, and promotes uniform deep Zn deposition. As a result, Zn//Zn cells operate for 3400 h at 1 mA cm −2 and 1 mAh cm −2 , for 1800 h at 5 mA cm −2 and 5 mAh cm −2 , and for 410 h at a depth of discharge of 42.7%. Zn//KVO full cells and pouch cells also show improved cycling stability. These results establish exogenous cation‐anion pairing as a practical route for ZIB interphase engineering.

papers.title: Interfacial Lithium Redox Kinetics Regulated by Solvent Asymmetry and Moment of Inertia in Li Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Il Rok Choi, Aditya Shah, Jeffrey Heo, Sanzeeda Baig Shuchi, John Holoubek, Jacob Florian, Jane K. J. Lee, Hao Lyu, Elizabeth Zhang, Jun Ho Lee, Yangju Lin, Yi Cui, Jian Qin, Zhenan Bao
papers.authorsCitation: I. R. Choi, A. Shah, J. Heo, S. B. Shuchi, J. Holoubek, J. Florian, J. K. J. Lee, H. Lyu, E. Zhang, J. H. Lee, Y. Lin, Y. Cui, J. Qin, Z. Bao
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) offer high energy density, but interfacial charge-transfer kinetics remain a bottleneck for high-rate operation. In this work, we construct a library of 12 ether solvents with systematic variations in symmetry and fluorination, confirming that molecular asymmetry is an important feature that results in enhanced Li+ redox kinetics and more stable solid electrolyte interphases on Li0. Furthermore, we developed a mechanistic understanding of the underlying process. We show that more tilted dipoles and lower moments of inertia strongly correlate with higher exchange current densities. Among the solvents in our study, the asymmetric F5MPE (1-methoxy-2-(2,2,3,3,3-pentafluoropropoxy) ethane) molecule, a previously unreported solvent molecule, enabled >170 stable cycles in high-rate Li||NMC full cells, outperforming the previously reported best single-salt-single-solvent ether solvent, F5DEE molecule. Overall, this work links molecular-level information with the behavior at electrochemical interfaces and provides an understanding of molecular design considerations for next-generation electrolytes tailored for high-power, fast-charging LMBs.

papers.title: Quantitative Dielectric Constant Engineering of the Separator for Reversible Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Tao Zhang, Xiao Li, Yuxuan Yu, Keith C. Gordon, Guiyin Xu, Meifang Zhu
papers.authorsCitation: T. Zhang, X. Li, Y. Yu, K. C. Gordon, G. Xu, M. Zhu
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Current research on separators for lithium metal batteries lacks unified theoretical frameworks and essential quantitative parameters, limiting reversibility, interfacial stability, and lifespan. Herein, we reveal a pronounced nonlinear correlation between the separator dielectric constant and ion transport kinetics. Specifically, an organic-aqueous interfacial reaction is employed to drive polycondensation on the polypropylene separator, enabling wide-range tuning of the separator dielectric constant (2.7–9.1). The dielectric constant serves as an effective descriptor of separator polarization under the internal electric field of the cell. The separator with an intermediate dielectric constant (∼5.4) optimizes the trade-off among ion transport kinetics, SEI stability, and lithium deposition, whereas excessively low or high dielectric constants favor organic-rich SEI formation and restricted transport kinetics, respectively. This strategy enables a Li||LiFePO4 pouch cell (416.4 Wh kg–1, excluding packaging weight) to retain 76.88% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles.

papers.title: Decoupling Ion Transport and Desolvation via Spatially Heterogeneous Solvation Structure for Wide‐Temperature Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.authors: Xin Chen, Jiaxin Yan, Xingyu Wang, Shilin Xu, Haixia Yang, Yuanheng Wang, Chunyu Du, Yulin Ma, Chuankai Fu, Pengjian Zuo
papers.authorsCitation: X. Chen, J. Yan, X. Wang, S. Xu, H. Yang, Y. Wang, C. Du, Y. Ma, C. Fu, P. Zuo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Despite competitive room‐temperature performance, sodium‐ion batteries suffer from sluggish kinetics and unstable interphases at ultralow temperatures. Herein, a single‐ether (diethylene glycol dibutyl ether, DGDE)‐based electrolyte featuring a spatially heterogeneous solvation structure across both the bulk and interfacial regions is successfully constructed by introducing a strongly polar sulfonate ester additive, 2,2,2‑trifluoroethyl trifluoromethanesulfonate (TTMS). In the bulk, DGDE chelates Na + via its multiple coordination sites to form a solvent‑separated ion pair dominated solvation structure, thereby enhancing ion dissociation and ionic conductivity. At the electrode–electrolyte interface, TTMS preferentially adsorbs onto the cathode surface, reconstructing the electric double layer into a compact, anion‐rich configuration dominated by contact ion pairs and aggregates. Meanwhile, TTMS in the inner Helmholtz plane provides desolvation‐active sites, lowering the charge‐transfer barrier and enabling the formation of a robust, inorganic‐rich interphase. This spatially heterogeneous solvation structure enables the decoupling of fast bulk ion transport and rapid interface desolvation. Consequently, at −40°C, the Na||NaNi 1/3 Fe 1/3 Mn 1/3 O 2 cell with the optimized electrolyte delivers an initial specific capacity of 109.9 mAh g −1 and sustains reversible cycling for 140 cycles with a capacity retention of 87.3%. Moreover, the cell demonstrates reliable electrochemical operation over a wide‐temperature range from −60°C to 55°C.

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Sparingly Soluble LiNO 3 in Carbonate Electrolytes With Pyridine as a Carrier Cosolvent for 450 Wh Kg −1 High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Fulu Chu, Zehao An, Junwei Meng, Chilin Li, Changzhou Yuan, Feixiang Wu
papers.authorsCitation: F. Chu, Z. An, J. Meng, C. Li, C. Yuan, F. Wu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT LiNO 3 is a highly effective electrolyte additive for ether‐based lithium metal batteries, but its extremely poor solubility in carbonate electrolytes has long restricted its application in high‐voltage high‐energy‐density systems. In this study, we develop a pyridine carrier cosolvent strategy to efficiently dissolve LiNO 3 in carbonate electrolytes. Pyridine coordinates with Li + to enter the solvation shell, weakening Li + ‐carbonate interactions to promote LiNO 3 dissolution and enable NO 3 − participation in interphase formation. The coordination effect also suppresses the intrinsic high reactivity of pyridine, realizing its controllable interfacial decomposition. The synergistic decomposition of pyridine and LiNO 3 constructs compact, inorganic‐dominated, rigid‐flexible interpenetrating electrode‐electrolyte interphases rich in Li 3 N, LiN x O y , and LiF with high mechanical strength. Benefiting from the optimized interphases, Li||Cu cells deliver a Coulombic efficiency (CE) of 97.3% at 2 mA cm −2 , and 4.5 V Li||NCM90 cells show outstanding cycling stability under practical thin‐lithium and lean‐electrolyte conditions. Remarkably, 5.6 Ah pouch cells achieve an energy density up to 453 Wh kg −1 with 95.5% capacity retention after 50 cycles. This work offers a facile approach for utilizing sparingly soluble functional additives and promotes the development of high‐voltage, high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries.

papers.title: Enhanced Sodium-Ion Transport across Solid Electrolyte Interphase via Electric-Field Modulation
papers.authors: Lu Jiang, Jinze Wang, Fei Chu, Jiale Zheng, Sen Jiang, Long Chen, Lixin Chen, Ping Wu, Ruhong Li, Tao Deng, Xiulin Fan
papers.authorsCitation: L. Jiang, J. Wang, F. Chu, J. Zheng, S. Jiang, L. Chen, L. Chen, P. Wu, R. Li, T. Deng, X. Fan
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract The ion transport properties of the solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) critically govern the kinetics and cycling stability of rechargeable batteries. However, a mechanistic understanding of ion transport within this dynamic, multicomponent interphase remains limited. In this study, we demonstrate that spatial variations in the internal electric field across the SEI dictates a fundamental transition in Na+ transport mechanisms. Within the thin SEI region adjacent to the electrode, a strong electric field dominates, enabling ballistic Na+ transport with minimal scattering and thus facilitating rapid ion migration. In contrast, in thicker SEI regions where the electric field is attenuated, frequent ion collisions dominate, resulting in diffusive transport and reduced ion mobility. To validate this mechanism, we combined molecular dynamics and density functional theory simulations to evaluate electrolyte reducibility based on salt–solvent interactions. These computational insights are complemented by in situ, nondestructive potentiostatic chronocoulometry technique to quantitatively determine SEI formation charge. A systematic evaluation of 23 representative electrolytes reveals a strong correlation between SEI formation charge and SEI resistance (RSEI), consistent with the electric-field-dependent ion transport model (R2 = 0.993). Notably, eight electrolytes exhibit SEI formation charges below 50% and low RSEI, proving suppressed SEI formation promotes ballistic Na+ migration. The optimal electrolyte, 1 M NaPF6 in tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether (TEGDME), forms a ∼21 nm SEI with merely 31.7% charge loss. Na||hard carbon cells using this electrolyte achieve 24.48 Ω cm2 interfacial impedance and retain 99.4% capacity after 1200 cycles. This work offers a mechanistic framework for designing high-performance interphases through electrolyte engineering.

papers.title: Regulating Solvation Chemistry via Strongly Coordinating Anion and Weakly Solvating Cosolvent for Low‐Temperature Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.authors: Genliang Yu, Qian Yang, Tongtong Huo, Mingyue Li, Xuejie Bai, Xiaobo Zhang, Jie Xu, Ting Lv, Xunzhu Zhou, Lin Li, Kaixiang Lei, Shijian Zheng
papers.authorsCitation: G. Yu, Q. Yang, T. Huo, M. Li, X. Bai, X. Zhang, J. Xu, T. Lv, X. Zhou, L. Li, K. Lei, S. Zheng
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Sodium metal batteries (SMBs) hold great promise for next‐generation energy storage systems due to their abundant sodium resources, high theoretical specific capacity, and low redox potential. However, they suffer from rapid capacity degradation at low operating temperatures, which inevitably hinders their practical application. In this work, we employ a strongly coordinating anion and a weakly solvating cosolvent to fabricate anion‐rich and varied solvation structures, aiming to enhance the low‐temperature electrochemical performance of SMBs. This unique solvation configuration efficiently reduces the Na + desolvation energy barrier, alleviates concentration polarization, accelerates liquid‐phase ion transport, and facilitates the in‐situ formation of a stable, highly ion‐conductive electrode‐electrolyte interphase. Benefiting from the synergistic regulation of interfacial stability and ion transport kinetics, dendrite‐free sodium deposition is achieved at −20°C, enabling stable cycling for over 500 h at 0.5 mA cm −2 and 0.5 mAh cm −2 . Additionally, the assembled SMBs exhibit excellent rate performance and cycling stability, delivering a high capacity retention of 70.54% and 68.28% after 1000 cycles at −20°C and −40°C, respectively. This work provides a novel perspective for the rational design of advanced electrolytes for high‐performance low‐temperature SMBs and lays a solid foundation for their practical application in cold environments.

papers.title: Reflex Charging for Anion‐Derived Solid Electrolyte Interphase Formation
papers.authors: Gyeoul Seong, Min‐Gyun Kim, Eunyeong Jung, Yerin Kang, Hong‐I Kim, Kwon‐Hyung Lee, Kohei Shimokawa, Won Bo Lee, Sang‐Young Lee, Seung‐Hyeok Kim
papers.authorsCitation: G. Seong, M. Kim, E. Jung, Y. Kang, H. Kim, K. Lee, K. Shimokawa, W. Bo Lee, S. Lee, S. Kim
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Lithium (Li) metal offers exceptional energy density but suffers from unstable interphases that lead to dendrite growth and poor reversibility. Because the interphase is established during the earliest stages of operation, controlling its formation is critical for stabilizing Li metal electrodes. Here, we demonstrate that a reflex charging strategy, in which short discharge pulses are introduced during charging, dynamically reprograms the interfacial environment. This approach sustains anion enrichment near the electrode surface and shifts Li + solvation from solvent‐dominated structures toward anion‐coordinated structures, thereby promoting the formation of an inorganic‐rich interphase. The resulting interphase reduces interfacial resistance and enables dense and uniform Li deposition. Consequently, the reflex charging‐based formation protocol exhibits markedly improved Li deposition/stripping reversibility, and greater resistance to degradation during cycling and calendar aging. In full cells paired with LiFePO 4 (LFP) cathodes, the system retains 73% capacity after 500 cycles, demonstrating practical performance benefits. These findings establish formation protocol as an effective operation‐driven lever for controlling interfacial chemistry, offering a practical route that complements conventional materials‐based strategies for stabilizing Li metal batteries (LMBs).

papers.title: Ion Bridging Enables Dual‐Interface Engineering for High Capacity and Long Cycling Aqueous Zinc–Sulfur Battery
papers.authors: Boao Wanyan, Xiang Liu, Jiahe Geng, Chaoyi Qiu, Zhichao Wang, Yaoyuan Zhan, Xikun Zhang, Hongxu Chen, Haoxiang Yu, Lei Yan, Xiaoting Lin, Liyuan Zhang, Ting‐Feng Yi, Jie Shu, Bao‐Lian Su
papers.authorsCitation: B. Wanyan, X. Liu, J. Geng, C. Qiu, Z. Wang, Y. Zhan, X. Zhang, H. Chen, H. Yu, L. Yan, X. Lin, L. Zhang, T. Yi, J. Shu, B. Su
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aqueous Zn–S batteries (AZSBs) have garnered significant attention owing to their high energy density and low cost. However, their practical application is hindered by the limited electrochemical reversibility of sulfur cathode and the interfacial instability of zinc anode. Here, we developed a functionalized co‐solvent electrolyte incorporating aprotic polar tetramethylurea (TMU) and potassium iodide (KI) as synergistic additives, where TMU regulates the Zn 2+ coordination environment and cooperates with iodide species to construct an electrolyte‐derived, interface‐confined, and coordination‐mediated dynamic ion bridge pathway. This pathway couples TMU‐regulated Zn 2+ transport with I 3 − /I − ‐mediated charge transfer at the sulfur cathode interface, thereby reducing the kinetic barriers for Zn 2+ transport and ZnS conversion. Meanwhile, the TMU/KI‐regulated interfacial environment homogenizes Zn 2+ flux at the anode, promotes uniform Zn plating/stripping, and suppresses parasitic reactions. Through the synergistic regulation of the ion bridge, the AZSB delivers a high specific capacity of 759 mAh g −1 at 5 A g −1 and maintains over 71.2% capacity retention after 1000 cycles. This work proposes a promising electrolyte design strategy for energetic AZSBs via synergistic regulation, offering a promising route toward next‐generation sustainable energy storage systems.

papers.title: Component Self‐Initiated Photopolymerization for Gel Polymer Electrolytes in Zinc–Air Batteries
papers.authors: Ping Li, Dagang Zhou, Boyi Fu, Lin Luo, Quan Liu, Wenli Yang, Mingming Deng, Jilan Long, Chi Huang, Qi Liu
papers.authorsCitation: P. Li, D. Zhou, B. Fu, L. Luo, Q. Liu, W. Yang, M. Deng, J. Long, C. Huang, Q. Liu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Flexible zinc–air batteries (FZABs) require gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs) to ensure ionic transport, interfacial stability, and mechanical flexibility, yet their development is limited by trade‐offs among mechanical robustness, low‐temperature tolerance, and fabrication efficiency. Herein, a component self‐initiated photopolymerization strategy is developed to achieve rapid gelation within minutes under visible‐light irradiation without external initiators, providing an efficient route for fabricating high‐performance GPEs. Within a proton‐rich microenvironment, sodium citrate (SC) undergoes proton‐coupled electron transfer to generate radicals that initiate the copolymerization of vinyl monomers within a sodium alginate (SA) matrix, forming a double‐network hydrogel (AAS x ‐SA). Additionally, SC induces network densification via the Hofmeister effect and modulates electrochemical properties, resulting in mechanically robust, dendrite‐suppressing, and freeze‐resistant GPEs. Consequently, the optimized AAS25‐SA‐GPE exhibits an ionic conductivity of 109 mS·cm −1 at −40°C and a freezing point of −69.1°C, enabling stable operation of the AAS25‐SA‐based FZAB for over 4220 cycles at −40°C. This work establishes an electrolyte design strategy in which a single electrolyte component integrates photoinitiation, structural construction, and electrochemical regulation, transforming electrolyte additives into active building blocks.

papers.title: An Electronically Coupled Interfacial Energy Descriptor for Predicting Coulombic Efficiency in Aqueous Zinc Batteries
papers.authors: Yuwei Cao, Song Yuan, Jiaqi Wei, Shengkai Cao, Huarong Xia, Bao Jin, Yang Hang, Tianyi Wang, Yuying Wang, Hao Chen, Wanlin Guo, Xian Jun Loh, Lin Jiang, Xiaodong Chen
papers.authorsCitation: Y. Cao, S. Yuan, J. Wei, S. Cao, H. Xia, B. Jin, Y. Hang, T. Wang, Y. Wang, H. Chen, W. Guo, X. J. Loh, L. Jiang, X. Chen
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Solid–liquid interfaces dictate the performance and longevity of aqueous batteries. While rationally designed electrolyte additives offer a potent strategy to stabilize these interfaces, the complex interactions between additives and metal surfaces are difficult to isolate experimentally, hindering the predictive design of optimal additives. Here, we introduce an electronically coupled interfacial energy descriptor (ΔG) that quantitatively captures additive-metal interactions. By unifying the energetic contributions of additive adsorption and interfacial charge transfer at the zinc surface into a single metric, ΔG provides a fundamental measure of interfacial stability. Integrating this descriptor with intrinsic molecular properties, we develop a machine learning framework that accurately predicts Coulombic efficiency across different additive families, successfully identifying pentaerythritol (PTT) as a highly effective candidate with a minimized ΔG value. Formulated with PTT additive, the ZnSO4 electrolyte enables highly reversible zinc plating and stripping with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.71%, sustaining stable cycling for over 1000 h, outperforming additives predicted by intrinsic molecular descriptors with a 2-fold longer cycle life. The resulting Zn–I2 full cells also sustain stable cycling under high-temperature and lean electrolyte conditions. Mechanistically, additives with minimized ΔG values preferentially accumulate at the interface to expel water molecules, promoting the formation of a robust solid electrolyte interphase composed of PTT- and anion-derived species. By redefining interfacial interactions through electronic-energetic coupling, this work provides a physically interpretable data-driven framework for additives screening in aqueous Zinc-ion batteries.

papers.title: Prismatic Na-Ion Coordination in the Sulfide-Chloride Solid Electrolyte Enables Fast Na-Ion Transport
papers.authors: Shufan Jia, Yu-Jie Guo, Xiaodong Qi, Liang Ma, Xu-Sheng Zhang, Wanli Wang, Lin-Bo Huang, Manyi Xie, Jian Wang, Haizhou Liu, Rui Wen, Yu-Guo Guo
papers.authorsCitation: S. Jia, Y.-J. Guo, X. Qi, L. Ma, X.-S. Zhang, W. Wang, L.-B. Huang, M. Xie, J. Wang, H. Liu, R. Wen, Y.-G. Guo
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Designing halide solid electrolytes with high ionic conductivity and robust electrochemical stability is crucial for advanced all-solid-state sodium-ion batteries. Currently, most sodium-based halide conductors suffer from the limited ionic conductivity. In this work, we report a new fast-ion-conductive sulfide-chloride solid electrolyte Na1.0Zr0.5Al0.5Cl3.5S0.5 (NZACS), where highly conductive prismatic Na-ion coordination units were developed by Al3+/S2–-triggered glass–ceramic evolution of the P21/n phase. The resulting material exhibits a high ionic conductivity of 3.2 × 10–4 S cm–1 at room temperature and 1.0 × 10–3 S cm–1 at 60 °C, and a low activation energy of 0.35 eV. Moreover, the excellent formability and high electrochemical oxidative stability of the NZACS solid electrolyte ensure a tight junction between the electrolyte-electrode interface, thus delivering superior cycling stability and rate capability, 93% capacity retention after 150 cycles at 0.1C and 80% capacity retention after 800 cycles at 1C. This study establishes a new paradigm of precise local-structure engineering for the development of high-performance solid electrolytes.

papers.title: Electron-Deficient Species-Driven Interphase Transformation for Practical Lithium Batteries
papers.authors: Xinru Wu, Zhihong Piao, Gongxun Lu, Guohuang Kang, Zhiyuan Han, Ruyu Shi, Yanze Song, Runhua Gao, Junfeng Li, Guangmin Zhou
papers.authorsCitation: X. Wu, Z. Piao, G. Lu, G. Kang, Z. Han, R. Shi, Y. Song, R. Gao, J. Li, G. Zhou
papers.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Lithium metal batteries with Ni-rich layered cathodes are promising candidates due to their high energy density; however, the unstable interphase formed in traditional carbonates accelerates premature irreversible capacity loss. In this study, we exploit the electron-deficient nature of boron (B)-containing species, which can initiate the chain polymerization of unstable alkyl lithium. This process facilitates the continuous conversion of these components into stable B-containing polymers, enhancing mechanical strength and ionic conductivity and ultimately achieving dynamic interphase transformation. Simultaneously, the unexpected generation of smaller solvation structures rich in multiple salt anions promotes Li+ transportation and the formation of LiF-rich interphases. Such an interphase bestows Li||LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 cells with a stable operation of up to 450 cycles under 4.6 V. Even practical 1.5 Ah graphite pouch cells can maintain 84% capacity after 1600 cycles. Thanks to the broad applicability of this unique in situ mechanism, it can be generalized to various LiPF6-based carbonate electrolytes. Our work provides a low-cost and highly accessible strategy for modifying the interphase, paving the way for high energy-density batteries that can meet diverse and demanding operating conditions.
